entities.name: Zora Jandová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zora Jandová is a Czech actress, radio presenter, and tai chi practitioner. She studied at the Faculty of Theatre in Prague, graduating in 1982. She acted at the National Theatre in Prague between 1982 and 1985.
